scenes.title: cyber-surface-observation
lines: In Cyberpunk, distinguish the reflections on wet pavement from the signs themselves. The same light appears at different places on the pavement as the viewpoint changes. In the on/off comparison, first check whether an object disappears or only its lighting changes. In the following reconstruction comparison, follow the lettering and umbrella edges. Observe both still-image clarity and the stability of detail during movement.

scenes.title: rivalry-surface-observation
lines: In the mobile demonstration, watch both the chest of the figure coming through the doorway and the floor. The armour retains its shape as the figure moves, while bright patterns on its surface and the floor change with the viewpoint. Practise separating data that describes an object’s shape from the lighting result on that shape. Connect the screen data discussed earlier to this actual movement.
